blocks.text: Original document: [docs/camera2d.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/camera2d.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
The `Camera2DController` provides a dedicated 2D orthographic camera system tailored for 2D animation scenes, interactive canvases, node graphs, map/CAD viewports, and 2D games.

items: **Buttery-Smooth Pan Momentum & Inertia**: Flick-and-glide pan dragging with exponential friction decay (`inertiaFriction`), matching the responsiveness and tactile feel of Figma, Miro, and Apple Maps.

**Continuous, Drift-Free Cursor-Invariant Zooming (`zoomAt`)**: Scales smoothly across continuous trackpad pinch gestures and notched wheel ticks, anchoring the world point under the cursor with exact mathematical invariance and zero drift throughout smooth zoom transitions.

**Frame-Rate Independent Exponential Damping**: Exact exponential decay curves ($\alpha = 1 - e^{-\text{damping} \cdot \Delta t}$) guaranteeing silky-smooth interpolation across 60Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz+, and variable refresh displays.
**Multi-Touch Pan & Pinch-to-Zoom**: Native gesture support for single-finger panning with momentum and two-finger pinch-to-zoom centered at the touch midpoint.
**Smooth Keyboard Navigation**: Smooth velocity acceleration and deceleration for `W`/`A`/`S`/`D` and Arrow key panning with diagonal normalization.
**Jitter-Free Target Tracking**: Smoothly tracks any `Entity` or `Vec3` coordinate with a configurable **Deadzone box** and **Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Velocity Look-Ahead** prediction.
**World Bounds Clamping**: Constrains camera position and visible viewport within world boundaries (`Camera2DBounds`).
**Zoom to Fit**: Automatically calculates center position and orthographic scale to frame a collection of entities.
**Screen Shake**: High-frequency procedural oscillation effect with quadratic falloff.
**Screen $\leftrightarrow$ World Coordinate Conversion**: Robust pixel-to-world and world-to-pixel coordinate projection taking into account canvas bounding client rect and aspect ratio.
**Declarative Animation System**: Fluid syntax integration with `scene.play(controller.animate.*)`.

blocks.text: To lock the camera onto an entity or moving coordinate:

items: **Deadzone (`{ width, height }`)**: Defines a rectangular region around the camera center where target movement does not trigger camera movement. When the target exits the deadzone box, the camera smoothly follows.

**Look-Ahead (`lookAheadFactor`)**: Predicts the target's trajectory using EMA-filtered velocity ($\vec{v}$) to smoothly position the camera ahead in the direction of travel without velocity spike jitter.
**Stopping Follow**: Call `controller.follow(null)` or trigger manual controls (pan, key move, scroll zoom).
